_comment: Metamagic catalogue. Initiation: Karma 10 + grade x 3 (SR4A); group initiation or ordeal -20%, both -40% (SM). Grade <= Magic; natural Magic max = 6 + grade. One metamagic per initiation (advanced ones need their prerequisite). Adepts: only entries with adeptAllowed. Optional rule (WotA p.14, listed as optional, standalone text not available): +1 Power Point instead of a metamagic on initiation -> sheet field initiation_pp. Way qualities (WotA) can raise effective grade for some metamagics: see supplements/magic/23.

metamagics.name: Adept Centering
metamagics.effect: Reduces negative dice pool modifiers to Physical and Combat skills by the initiate grade, as long as she can physically perform her centering method. | SM: As core (file 06).

metamagics.name: Centering
metamagics.effect: + grade dice to all Drain Resistance Tests. Requires a Free Action in the same Action Phase as the Drain test; the character must be able to move and speak freely and may attract attention (chanting, dancing, gestures…).

metamagics.name: Flexible Signature
metamagics.effect: Alter or disguise astral signatures at will: forge another magician's signature (must have assensed it), disguise one's own, or shorten durations by grade hours. Assensing a faked signature: threshold + grade (grade 2 forger: 3 hits to see the fake, 5 to realize it is fake and see the true one). Grade 3 leaves no signature for Force ≤ 3 effects; a Force 5 effect lasts only 2 hours.

metamagics.name: Masking
metamagics.effect: Change the apparent aura/astral form: look mundane, look as if Magic were ±grade, or look like another astral creature (needs astral projection capability). Assensing an aura: Assensing + Intuition opposed by Intuition + Magic + grade; fewer hits = only the false aura; more hits = both.

metamagics.name: Quickening
metamagics.effect: Make a sustained spell self-sustaining: cast normally, then Complex Action + 1 Karma per point of Force. No sustaining penalty afterwards, but the spell can still be traced to the caster. A quickened spell adds dice equal to the Karma spent to its tests (including against dispelling); extra Karma (up to Force more) can be spent to harden it. If disrupted (e.g. an astral barrier), it ends; the caster can end it any time while perceiving it. Karma spent is lost when it ends; the caster is aware of any dispelling.

metamagics.name: Shielding
metamagics.effect: + grade dice to Counterspelling when protecting against hostile spells (self or others); only for Counterspelling in spell defense.

metamagics.name: Ally Conjuration
metamagics.effect: Needed to summon ally spirits (SM p.103): mold a bound spirit according to an ally spirit formula.

metamagics.name: Attunement (Animal)
metamagics.effect: Befriend a mundane, non-sapient animal (Intuition + Charisma (12, 1 week)), then bonding ritual costs Karma = animal's Essence. Limited to one animal type per learning; attuned animals ≤ grade; one benefit at a time; can be severed (Karma lost); canceled on death; works as a material link. Cannot attune prepared vessels or sapient critters. Grants the Sense Link power. Groups of small animals may count as one (GM). Very large animals: higher thresholds/Karma. | Sense Link power: M, Simple, range Magic × 10 m, Always. Adept experiences the animal's senses (one at a time) and sends simple commands (GM may ask Intuition + Charisma); augmented senses/astral sight don't work through it; dual natured animal's astral sight is a separate sense. If the animal is hurt, the adept resists the same DV as Stun with Willpower + Magic.

metamagics.name: Attunement (Item)
metamagics.effect: Familiarize (Logic + Technical skill (12, 1 week), or build it), then ritual Karma cost: 5 simple handcrafted (blades, instruments); 6 modern crafted mechanical (katana, lockpick kit); 8 basic production-line (basic gun, dirt bike); 9 tech-intensive (smartgun, car, racing bike); 10 high-tech (monofilament whip, thunderbird, commlink). Gives + half grade (round up) dice to skill tests using/handling the item; not via electronic interface, not on foci/prepared vessels/enchanted items, not on Active Magical skills. One item type per learning; attuned items ≤ grade; Karma lost if severed; usable as a material link.

metamagics.name: Channeling
metamagics.effect: A willingly possessed magician keeps her own skills and fine motor control while enjoying Possession benefits; control is shared; she cannot use the spirit's powers without expending a service; the vessel resists mana spells/powers with the lower Mental attribute of the two minds. (Possession rules: SM p.101.)

metamagics.name: Cleansing
metamagics.effect: On-site, astrally perceiving/projecting. Magic + Counterspelling + grade, threshold = background count ÷ 2 (round up, min 1); each net hit temporarily −1 background count; 1 Complex Action per point. If the count is 0 (or none), a separate test (1 Complex Action) erases all astral traces/signatures, threshold = highest signature Force. The natural count returns after grade hours; permanent only if the cause is removed; useless against strong sites (Hiroshima, Stonehenge).

metamagics.name: Cognition
metamagics.effect: Complex Action, Magic + Logic (2) + grade; each net hit shifts 1 point between Mental attributes (2 Combat Turns per point to take effect, lasts Magic minutes, stay within augmented max, min 1). At the end: 3 DV Stun per attribute point shifted (cumulative), resisted with Willpower + Body.

metamagics.name: Divining
metamagics.effect: Needs to assense the subject or have a material link. Mild trance (−2 dice to all actions); ask one question about a future event. Always gets a vision; decode with Arcana + Logic (+ grade); threshold by question: Vague 1, General 2, Specific 3, Very specific 4; +1 threshold per repeated attempt until the situation changes. Net hits: 1 cryptic truth, 2 mildly helpful, 3+ the desired detail; glitch = misleading. GM may roll secretly.

metamagics.name: Geomancy
metamagics.effect: Aspect the background count of a site (domain). Ritual Spellcasting as if casting a spell of Force = 2 × site's background count, threshold 2 × count; Drain (Force) DV for participants. Must be completed once per lunar month for as many months in a row as the site's background count; a failed month only postpones. Competing geomancers: only the most net hits count. The site must respect the tradition's geomantic lore (re-sculpt if needed).

metamagics.name: Great Ritual
metamagics.effect: In Ritual Spellcasting, act as a conduit instead of casting (adds no dice): adds Magic to the maximum group size and to the maximum Force of the spell; cannot be team leader; suffers Drain like others.

metamagics.name: Invoking
metamagics.effect: Declare when performing a binding/rebinding ritual: its Drain +50% (round up). If it succeeds, Complex Action Invoking Test: Magic + Binding + spirit's Force. Hits: 0–1 fails; 2 +1 Reach and +1 die per hit to resist Banishing; 3 one additional optional power (as if Force +3); 4 LOS powers (and Engulf) usable as LOS (A) area effect (may exclude targets); 5 a unique great form power (below); 6+ each net hit over 5 gives +1 to each materialized/possession Physical attribute (up to augmented max). Rebinding a great form spirit: no new test, Drain +50%. Watchers cannot be invoked.

metamagics.name: Psychometry
metamagics.effect: Physical contact + Intuition + Assensing + grade. Modifiers: time since impression <1 day 0, <1 week −2, <1 month −4, <1 year −6, <1 decade −8, each further decade −2; strong connection of the subject to the impression +2; initiate's connection +2; violence/powerful emotion +3; violent death +4; subject is a bonded focus + Rating (only for impressions of its owner); place −2; chaotic surroundings −1; more than one significant impression −1 each; erased signatures −1; Cleansing used −6; each repeat on the same object −2. Net hits: 0 nothing, 1 flashes, 2 deeper, 3 detail and multi-sense, 4+ lengthy coherent visions. +3 dice during a long intense reading.

metamagics.name: Sensing
metamagics.effect: Complex Action, Magic + Intuition + grade; no astral perception/LOS needed. Detects mana ebbs/surges, mana storms, rifts, shallows, voids, alchera, background count (not astral forms, spells, barriers, spirits, foci). Range = grade × 500 m × phenomenon rating. Results by the Detection Spell Results table. GM may roll secretly for passive detection.

metamagics.name: Somatic Control
metamagics.effect: Complex Action, Magic + Body (2) + grade; each net hit shifts 1 point between Physical attributes (2 Combat Turns/point, lasts Magic minutes, augmented max, min 1). Afterwards 3 DV Stun per point shifted (cumulative), resisted with Willpower + Body.

metamagics.name: Sympathetic Linking
metamagics.effect: Unlocks sympathetic links and symbolic links (see file 10) for ritual magic and astral tracking.

metamagics.name: Absorption
metamagics.effect: Spell Resistance Test with Counterspelling + grade; each hit absorbs 1 Force as "mana charge" (up to the spell's Force), kept grade turns; each point reduces Drain DV of her own spellcasting by 1. Max charge = Magic; charge above Magic causes 1 DV Physical per point (cumulative). Unused charge when time runs out = Drain with DV = remaining charge (Physical if above Magic). Cannot absorb from own or reflected spells.

metamagics.name: Anchoring
metamagics.effect: Add an anchor to a spell with trigger conditions defined before casting; works on instant, sustained and permanent spells. Resist Drain twice (spell + anchor); variable-Drain spells commit a DV. Pay 1 Karma per point of the spell's Force. Treated like quickened spells for astral purposes. When triggered the spell discharges as if just cast (uses recorded hits), caster suffers no Drain. Contact-only targeting unless a Detection trigger. Mental command can activate/deactivate it at any range. Active anchors ≤ grade. Needed for anchoring foci (SM p.84). Triggers (chosen at creation, may be chained): Background Count (count modified in any way), Contact (living aura, specific aura, or any aura but the caster's touches it), Detection Spell (a quickened Detection spell linked to the anchor detects the target and targets the spell), Timing (1 Combat Turn up to Force months). An anchor has no senses of its own. *(The OCR of the trigger text is partly garbled; other trigger conditions such as Command/Time may exist in the printed book — verify.)*

metamagics.name: Empower Animal
metamagics.effect: Lend one adept power to an attuned animal via Sense Link range; first transfer costs Karma = PP cost × 3 (round up); then free. Complex Action; one power at a time, unavailable to the adept meanwhile; PP transferred ≤ grade. If the animal lacks the needed skill it uses the adept's unmodified skill at −2.

metamagics.name: Extended Masking
metamagics.effect: Mask a number of foci/spells (not her own aura) ≤ grade, each of Force ≤ Magic. Detection: Assensing + Intuition vs Intuition + Magic + grade; more hits reveals the masked items too.

metamagics.name: Filtering
metamagics.effect: Complex Action Magic + Counterspelling vs threshold background count − grade (min 1); (background count does not reduce Magic for this test); each net hit −1 effective background count for the initiate for Magic turns before the weave clogs. Works on domains and mana warps, not ebbs or voids.

metamagics.name: Flux
metamagics.effect: Scramble the links to bonded foci, attuned animals/items, spirits, barriers, active spells, ritual links; tracking/targeting is put on hold. Safe for Magic hours per day; beyond that 50% chance a link is permanently broken (foci unbond, spirits released, spells fail); another Magic hours that day = all broken; GM may add permanent aura damage (Magic loss, negative qualities). Flux makes the aura stand out astrally.

metamagics.name: Infusion
metamagics.effect: Complex Action: 0.5 PP "boost" per grade, used for Magic minutes. Afterwards Drain DV = Magic (Stun, Willpower + Body) and an equal number of PP of normal powers are burned out for the same duration (GM chooses which, secretly).

metamagics.name: Reflecting
metamagics.effect: When resisting a spell that targets her directly (area or personal) and of which she is aware: counts as an interrupt full defense (uses her next action); Counterspelling + grade; if she scores more hits than the caster's Spellcasting hits, the spell is reflected at the caster with Force halved (round up), her net hits as hits; always single target; others she protected are unaffected.
